title: Trial of Six full run not played: only fight 1 (Inferno Wyrm) reached, by a bot, 3 attempts
steps: Desktop 1280x720, ?mode=world&test=1&seed=12345, Lv25 save; Enter at the Nexus did not open it (hero 128 px from the portal); Trial started with world.rush.start() hook
Fight 1 with a scripted mouse + WASD hero
expected: Six fights timed, damage and bolt readability noted
actual: Attempt 1 (hero stayed near the boss): dead in 16.7 s from 252 HP with up to 40 enemy bolts live (about 15 HP/s).
